title: Poker Night Rebuy Pressure
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokernow:session rebuys=*
| stats sum(rebuys) as total_rebuys, avg(bankroll_delta_usd) as avg_bankroll_delta by table_name player_name
| sort - total_rebuys
description: Shows which players and tables trigger the most rebuys and the worst average bankroll swings.
value: Rebuy pressure is a quick proxy for whether a home game is landing in the sweet spot or turning into a punt-fest.
implementation: Export rebuys and bankroll deltas from Poker Now and review the results per table and player.
visualization: Table of players by total rebuys and average bankroll delta.
grandmaExplanation: It watches where poker night keeps turning into extra buy-ins and bigger swings.
